一撮土、一滴水、我们的皮肤，里面可能藏着不同的小邻居。换一个地方，再打开想象中的: A pinch of soil, a drop of water and our skin can host different tiny neighbors. Choose a place and open an imaginary magnifying lens.
土粒之间有孔隙，里面可以有空气、水和养分。不同的细菌、真菌和其他微生物，住在适合: Spaces between soil grains can hold air, water and nutrients. Bacteria, fungi and other microbes occupy suitable niches; some help break down fallen leaves and recycle materials.
水分、养分和孔隙各不相同。: Water, nutrients and pore spaces vary.
池水里可能有细菌、微小的藻类和原生生物。有的利用光，有的利用其他食物。清澈与浑浊: Pond water may contain bacteria, microscopic algae and protists. Some use light; others use other food sources. Clarity or cloudiness alone cannot tell us which microbes are present.
光、水和可用养分影响谁能生长。: Light, water and available nutrients shape growth.
皮肤上生活着微生物。干燥、湿润和油脂较多的部位，常有不同的群落。遇见微生物不等于: Microbes live on our skin. Dry, moist and oily areas often host different communities. Meeting a microbe does not automatically mean illness: its identity, location and our condition matter.
同一张皮肤，也有不同的小环境。: One skin surface contains different niches.
有时，只是在搭便车: Sometimes they are just passing through
一些微生物或它们的孢子，会随着尘粒、飞沫和气流迁移。被带到一个地方，不等于能在那: Some microbes or their spores travel with dust, droplets and air currents. Arrival does not guarantee growth: dryness, sunlight and scarce nutrients limit many microbes.
到达、存活、繁殖，是三件不同的事。: Arrival, survival and reproduction are different.
选择环境并观察微生物示意图: Choose an environment and explore a microbial illustration
环境和其中微小居民的放大示意，颜色、数量与大小均为教学示意: An environment and enlarged tiny residents; colors, counts and sizes are illustrative
这不是实拍，也不能用来判断一处环境是否安全。: This is an illustration, not a way to judge whether a place is safe.
我们看不见单个小居民，仍可能有它们生活的空间。看不见和不存在，是两回事。: A place can hold tiny residents even when we cannot see them individually. Invisible does not mean absent.
水流、尘粒、动物和接触，都可能搬运微生物。它们不是从空白里凭空冒出来的。: Water, dust, animals and contact can transport microbes. They do not appear from nothing.
有的适应寒冷，有的适应温暖，有的能在缺氧处生活。许多种类一起分布得广，不是每一种: Some are adapted to cold, some to warmth, and some can live without oxygen. Many different kinds have a broad collective range; each kind has limits.
这些名字，不是四个并排的盒子: These names are not four separate boxes
细胞是生命的基本结构和功能单位。细菌属于由细胞构成的生物；微生物是对微小生物的宽: Cells are the basic structural and functional units of life. Bacteria are cellular organisms. Microbe is a broad term covering tiny organisms, including many fungi, archaea and protists. Viruses are not cells, and are also studied in microbiology.
“几乎无处不在”描述总体分布，不是说每个位置、每个时刻都有活微生物。图中形状、颜: Almost everywhere describes a broad distribution, not living microbes at every location at every moment. Shapes, colors and counts are teaching symbols, not measurements or identified species. An ordinary magnifying glass cannot resolve most individual microbes. Presence in air does not imply sustained reproduction there. Viruses require suitable living cells to make more viruses; bacterial growth rules cannot simply be applied to them.
换着看土壤、池水、皮肤和空气，分清被带到、活下来与长出更多。: Explore soil, pond water, skin and air, and distinguish arrival, survival and reproduction.
从生活里，走进微小世界: From everyday places into a tiny world
同一小环境的连续放大示意，颜色和大小不按真实比例: A continuous closer view of the same habitat; illustrative colours and sizes
打开想象放大镜，看看这里的小环境。: Open the imagined lens and explore this tiny habitat.
科学插画 · 示意着色 · 不同物体不按同一比例: Scientific illustration · Illustrative colours · Objects not to a common scale
从落叶和根附近，走进土粒间的孔隙。: From leaves and roots into the spaces between soil grains.
灰绿的水膜贴着土粒，细菌分布在其中。浅色分枝是真菌的菌丝，可以穿过颗粒之间的空间: Grey-green water films coat soil grains, with bacteria in them. The pale branches are fungal hyphae that can cross spaces between grains. They are enlarged here for comparison.
水面看起来很平静，微小世界却很丰富。: Still-looking water can contain a diverse tiny world.
绿色细胞示意微小藻类，体内有叶绿体；较大的长圆形示意有纤毛的原生生物。它们和细菌: The green cells represent microscopic algae with chloroplasts; the larger oval represents a ciliated protist. Their structures differ from bacteria. Colour alone cannot identify real species.
皮肤的表面并不是一块光滑的玻璃。: The skin surface is not smooth like glass.
层层角质细胞形成表面，沟纹、毛孔附近的条件也不同。这里放大的细菌只是居民的代表；: Layers of flattened outer skin cells form the surface. Grooves and pores have different local conditions. Enlarged bacteria here represent some residents; skin hosts other microbes too.
风会搬运微小颗粒，也可能带着微生物。: Wind carries tiny particles, sometimes with microbes.
尘粒，是一段旅程: A journey on a dust particle
圆形的小孢子附在这颗尘粒上，旁边还有带着细菌的液滴示意。这里画的是运输；被风带着: Round spores cling to this dust particle; a nearby droplet is shown carrying bacteria. This depicts transport: travelling on the wind does not mean reproducing in the air.
